title.ko: 협상: I'd be willing to · on condition that · meet halfway · bottom line
title.en: negotiating and persuading: I'd be willing to, on condition that, meet halfway, the bottom line

explain.ko: 협상 영어는 입장을 분명히 하면서도 관계를 해치지 않는 완곡한 표현이 중요합니다. 제안은 I'd be willing to ..., We could offer ..., 조건은 on condition that ..., provided that ..., 절충은 meet halfway, split the difference, 거절은 I'm afraid that's difficult for us, 최종 제안은 Our bottom line is ...를 사용합니다. 서로에게 이익이 되는 해결책(win-win)을 강조하면 설득력이 높아집니다.
explain.en: Negotiating English must state your position while preserving the relationship, so tentative phrasing matters. Offers: I'd be willing to ..., We could offer ...; conditions: on condition that ..., provided that ...; compromise: meet halfway, split the difference; refusal: I'm afraid that's difficult for us; final offer: Our bottom line is .... Stressing a win-win solution increases persuasiveness.

task.model: We would be willing to sign for a ten per cent discount. On condition that you deliver one week earlier. Why don't we meet halfway with a five per cent discount and delivery ten days earlier? In that case, we'll proceed on these terms.

model_trans.en: We would be willing to sign for a ten per cent discount. On condition that you deliver one week earlier. Why don't we meet halfway with a five per cent discount and delivery ten days earlier? In that case, we'll proceed on these terms.
